description: C1 (decision C1-12): what act one's settlements answer when the rim breaks - aid sent or refused, by how the giant left each one (its oath and how it was won, its standing, Skarn's fate, Harrok's). Set once as act two begins (ActTwo.begin: pledge.<id> = sends | refuses, and pledge.<id>.sends / .refuses); spoken at the Stone Throne by the rim council (dialogue.rim_council, built from this table: tests/unit/test_act_two.gd keeps them together). Milestone D consumes the flags (the Frostbound's assault on the Stonehold: who stands with the giant).

pledges.speaker: Marchwarden Edda
pledges.sends_line: Brannock's word, from Marchwarden Edda: the March keeps its oath. Spears and carts will come up the Ironway when you call.
pledges.refuses_line: Brannock's word, from Marchwarden Edda: the March swore to no one, or swore under the shadow of your fist. It will bar its gates and keep its own.

pledges.speaker: Wren of Hollowmere
pledges.sends_line: The Greywood's word, from Wren: the woodfolk remember the den. Our foresters will mark the passes above the rim for you.
pledges.refuses_line: The Greywood's word, from Wren: the woodfolk owe you nothing. The trees will hide them, not guide you.

pledges.speaker: Aldmere's herald
pledges.sends_line: Aldmere's word, from its herald: the crown made peace with you, and keeps it. What is left of the regiment will hold the Ironway.
pledges.refuses_line: Aldmere's word, from its herald: the crown remembers its burned engines and its broken regiment. Aldmere will look to its own walls.

pledges.speaker: Ulfra of Skarn
pledges.sends_line: Skarn's word, from Ulfra: our halls stand because of you. Skarn's giants will walk with you beyond the rim.
pledges.refuses_line: Skarn's word, from Ulfra: Skarn burned, or Skarn was wronged. We will mourn our halls, not follow you.

pledges.speaker: Reeve Tamsin
pledges.sends_line: Millford's word, from Reeve Tamsin: the quarry works again and the mill turns. Stone and bread will go north to you.
pledges.refuses_line: Millford's word, from Reeve Tamsin: Millford has little left to give, and less reason to give it.

pledges.speaker: Harrok's clan
pledges.sends_line: Harrok's clan sends word: the Unbowed lives because you let him. When the heights come down, his clan will stand at the Moot.
pledges.refuses_line: Harrok's clan sends no word. They burned their chief on the hill and turned their faces from the Moot: they will come for the throne, not for you.
